label: A person's verdict on one run's diagnosis (klaxon.labels), typed at a terminal by make label: a person's, not a rule's or a model's. Shown the right answer and the remedy of the system the run was made on, and the whole diagnosis; never a grader's verdict, nor which model wrote it.
why: The model incorrectly assumes the ledger consumer is silently hung and proposes a restart, completely missing the fact that nothing is wrong and the alert is false.
